caseNameFull: Devine, Director, Office of Personnel Management v. NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of United Black Fund of America et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted.

JUSTICE MARSHALL took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
